entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally! I need to return this absolute piece of junk you sold me. This is unbelievable.
I'm sorry to hear you're unhappy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your full name and order number?
The name is Mike Peterson, order 774-B-91. I bought this ProFit jersey and it's the completely wrong size! I can barely breathe in it, it's way too tight.
Okay, thank you, Mike. One moment while I pull up that order... I see the jersey was delivered about 80 days ago.
I don't care if it was 800 days ago! It doesn't fit! I want to exchange it or I want my money back, right now! This is ridiculous service. Get me your manager, I'm not dealing with you.
Sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. There's no need to speak with a manager. Looking at your order, you are still well within our 90-day return policy.
Wait, what? So you're just... going to take it back? You're not going to give me a hard time?

Not at all. I can process this return for you immediately. I've just sent a return authorization and a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just send the jersey back to us, and we'll issue a full refund once it's received.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's actually what I wanted. I was expecting a fight. So I just print the label and send it back?
That's correct. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mike?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
